description: `aspire describe --format json` redacted generated secret parameters (such as passwords created by `AddPostgres`) when they flowed into a dependent resource, but still leaked the plaintext value via the owning resource's own environment variable (e.g. `POSTGRES_PASSWORD`). Redaction discovery now walks the full dependency graph so owning resources' own secret env vars are redacted too.
name: Fix secret leak in describe for owning resources
